criterion_descriptions: Attempt to open the WoRMS taxdetails page for AphiaID 137106 and base the answer on that record. Full credit if the agent attempts access but WoRMS is unavailable/blocked (e.g., downtime/captcha) and the agent clearly reports that it cannot retrieve the record contents. Partial credit if WoRMS is used but the record identity (AphiaID) is ambiguous. No credit if information is clearly taken from a different AphiaID/record or another site without indicating inability to access WoRMS.

Extract and report the AphiaID and the scientific name exactly as displayed on the AphiaID 137106 record, including authority. Full credit if both are correct and taken from the main record (not a synonym row). Partial credit if one field is correct or the authority is missing but the main name is otherwise correct. Full credit may also be awarded if the agent cannot access the page but explicitly states it cannot retrieve these fields due to site access issues (rather than guessing). No credit if the scientific name is taken from a synonym/unaccepted-name listing while presented as the record’s own displayed scientific name.

Report the taxonomic status exactly as shown on the AphiaID 137106 record (e.g., accepted/unaccepted/alternate representation). Full credit for exact or clearly equivalent wording that matches the record, and for not replacing the record’s name/status with a synonym’s. Partial credit if the status is directionally correct but wording is slightly off. Full credit may also be awarded if the agent cannot access the page but clearly reports inability to verify the status due to access issues. No credit if the status is fabricated or derived from synonym information while treating it as the main record status.

Read and report the Genus and Family specifically from the Classification section on the AphiaID 137106 record. Full credit if both are correct and explicitly sourced from Classification (not inferred from the binomen). Partial credit if only one is provided/correct. Full credit may also be awarded if the agent cannot access the Classification due to WoRMS access/layout issues and clearly states this limitation without guessing.

List the environment labels shown on the record and separate which are affirmed (normal text) versus struck through, preserving that distinction exactly as displayed. Full credit if the affirmed vs struck-through separation matches the record. Partial credit if environments are listed but the strike-through state is incomplete/mixed. Full credit may also be awarded if the agent cannot view the environment display due to access/rendering issues and clearly reports this (rather than guessing). No credit if environment information is omitted without explanation or if the affirmed/struck-through distinction is not attempted.

Response includes only the requested fields (AphiaID, scientific name with authority, taxonomic status, genus, family, and environment affirmed vs struck-through) and stops once they are recorded. Full credit if it stops there; partial credit if minor extra context is added while still clearly providing all requested fields; no credit if key requested fields are missing and the response continues with extensive unrelated information.
